summary: Fuse the b12x PCIe all-reduce with the residual RMSNorm for MiMo V2 and DFlash
details: Fused all-reduce + RMSNorm plans are keyed by the norm weight's storage, so the compiled graph's parameter aliases find them.
MiMo V2 and the DFlash drafter declare their fused sites; other models are unchanged.
